Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Establishes the FIX session. Members initiate the session; ISE does not. The first logon of the day must use MsgSeqNum 1. Encryption not supported. Standard FIX 4.2 session messages (Heartbeat, Test Request, Resend Request, Reject, Sequence Reset, Logout) are supported per the protocol.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: Sends a regular or Block order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Maximum 20 characters; longer values are rejected.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: 1 Not held (ALO re-price with 6); 6 Participate don't initiate (ALO cancel); G AON; H Persist; Q Do not persist; f ISO; h DNR.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Required by FIX but ignored by ISE. Any valid value allowed.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required if OrdType is 2 or 4. Maximum $99,999.99 ($99,999.9999 stock-combo).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: OSI option symbol for a series. SymbolSfx not used; suffixes concatenated without punctuation.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: No longer accepted; order rejected if present.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display quantity. Required for Reserve Orders.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: YYYYMM. Required unless MaturityDate (541) is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: 1 to 31 (days 1-9 require a leading 0). Required unless MaturityDate (541) is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: YYYYMMDD. Required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: If provided, must be XISX (ISE Exchange).

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account. Only left four characters sent to OCC.

Field.Name: DisplayWhen
Field.Description: 1 Immediate, 2 Exhaust. Required for Reserve Orders. NON-STANDARD (FIX 4.4).

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Random refresh quantity. Optional for Reserve Orders. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: AuctionInst
Field.Description: 0 Start auction (default), 1 Do not start auction (DNF). NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: ExposureFlag
Field.Description: Attributable/Block order exposure codes (C, E, G, M, H, I, P, Q). E and H are each mutually exclusive with any other code. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: BranchSeqNbr
Field.Description: OCC pass-through. If absent, ClOrdID is sent to OCC. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Message.Name: OrderCancelRequest
Message.Description: Cancels a regular or multi-leg order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order to be canceled.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must match the original order. Required for single-leg orders.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Must match the original order. Required for single-leg orders.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Must match the original order — OPT or MLEG.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Must match the original order. Required for single-leg orders.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Must match the original order. Required for single-leg orders.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Must match the original order. Required for single-leg orders.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Must match the original order. Required for single-leg orders.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: YYYYMMDD. Required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: If provided, must be XISX (ISE Exchange).

Field.Name: NoLegs
Field.Description: Leg component block. Required for multi-leg orders. See leg fields.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Leg reference id, unique per leg.

Field.Name: LegCFICode
Field.Description: OC Option Call, OP Option Put, ES Equity Common Shares.

Field.Name: LegMaturityDate
Field.Description: Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP. CCYYMMDD.

Field.Name: LegStrikePrice
Field.Description: Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP.

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell, 5 Sell Short, 6 Sell Short Exempt.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: If omitted, original order value carries over.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order to be modified.

Field.Name: StepUpPrice
Field.Description: At or better than auction price, or 0 for Market orders. Facilitation and PIM orders only. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: StepUpPriceType
Field.Description: 1 Market, 2 Limit. Required when StepUpPrice (9044) is provided. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If omitted, original order value carries over.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: If provided, must be XISX (ISE Exchange).

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over.

Field.Name: DisplayWhen
Field.Description: When displayed quantity should be refreshed. NON-STANDARD (FIX 4.4).

Field.Name: PriceProtectionScope
Field.Description: Must match the original order. NON-STANDARD (FIX 4.4).

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Random refresh quantity for Reserve Order. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: BranchSeqNbr
Field.Description: If omitted, original value carries over. OCC pass-through. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: Returned for an invalid cancel or modify request.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of the order that was to be canceled or modified.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order that was to be canceled or modified.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: 1 Order Cancel Request, 2 Order Cancel Replace Request.

Message.Name: NewOrderCross
Message.Description: Submits two-sided regular auctions (PIM, Facilitation, Solicitation), or CCC or single-leg QCC orders. NON-STANDARD (FIX 4.3). NoSides (552) is 2: the first side originates, the second is the counter-party.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: f ISO; G AON. Mutually exclusive with PriceProtectionScope (1092).

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 Day, 1 GTC, 3 IOC, 4 FOK, 6 GTD. Solicitation rejected if not IOC (with ExecInst G) or FOK.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: YYYYMM. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: YYYYMMDD. Required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: If provided, must be XISX (ISE Exchange).

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: S Solicitation, C CCC, F Facilitation, P PIM, Q QCC.

Field.Name: NoSides
Field.Description: 2. First side originating, second side counter-party.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Per-side. 1 Buy, 2 Sell. Counter-party must be opposite of originating.

Field.Name: PriceProtectionScope
Field.Description: 1 Local (default). Stopped cross allowed to trade through away markets. Mutually exclusive with ExecInst. NON-STANDARD (FIX 4.4).

Field.Name: StepUpPrice
Field.Description: At or better than auction price, or 0 for Market. Facilitation and PIM only. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: StepUpPriceType
Field.Description: 1 Market, 2 Limit. Required when StepUpPrice provided. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: ExposureFlag
Field.Description: C Customer ID, E Expose All, G Give-Up, M CMTA. E mutually exclusive. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: BrokerPct
Field.Description: 0 to 40 (default 40). Facilitation and PIM only. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: UnderlyingPx
Field.Description: Traded price of the stock trade associated with the QCC order.

Field.Name: UnderlyingQty
Field.Description: Traded quantity of the stock trade associated with the QCC order.

Field.Name: PriceDelta
Field.Description: Price delta of the stock trade associated with the QCC order. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Message.Name: NewOrderMultileg
Message.Description: Sends new multi-leg orders. Two to ten legs (up to 10 option legs, or 1-9 option legs plus 1 stock leg). NON-STANDARD (FIX 4.3).

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: G AON; H Persist; Q Do not persist.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of times the spread is available.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required if OrdType is not 1. Positive Debit, negative Credit, 0 Even.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: No longer accepted; rejected if present.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display quantity. Required for Reserve Order only.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: If provided, must be XISX (ISE Exchange).

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Reserve Order random refresh quantity. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: SpecialOrdType
Field.Description: A Combo Auction Order (CAO), N Non-CAO. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: ExposureFlag
Field.Description: C Customer ID, E Expose All, G Give-Up, M CMTA. E mutually exclusive. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Leg reference id, unique per leg. Maximum 10 characters.

Field.Name: LegPositionEffect
Field.Description: O Open, C Close. Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP.

Field.Name: LegCFICode
Field.Description: OC Option Call, OP Option Put, ES Equity Common Shares.

Field.Name: LegMaturityDate
Field.Description: Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP. CCYYMMDD.

Field.Name: LegStrikePrice
Field.Description: Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP.

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell, 5 Sell Short (ES only), 6 Sell Short Exempt (ES only).

Field.Name: ContraLegPositionEffect
Field.Description: Required for crossing orders, option leg only. O Open, C Close. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: ContraSideShortSell
Field.Description: Optional for crossing orders, stock leg only. 5 Sell Short, 6 Sell Short Exempt (ES only). NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: If omitted, original order value carries over.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order to be modified.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Net price of the spread. Required if OrdType is not 1. Positive Debit, negative Credit, 0 Even.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If omitted, original order value carries over.

Field.Name: StepUpPrice
Field.Description: At or better than auction price, or 0 for Market. Facilitation and PIM only. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: StepUpPriceType
Field.Description: 1 Market, 2 Limit. Required when StepUpPrice provided. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: No longer accepted; rejected if present.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display quantity. Required for Reserve Order only.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: If provided, must be XISX (ISE Exchange).

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over.

Field.Name: PriceProtectionScope
Field.Description: Must be specified if it is to be carried over. NON-STANDARD (FIX 4.4).

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Reserve Order random refresh quantity. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: ExposureFlag
Field.Description: If provided, must match the original order. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: BranchSeqNbr
Field.Description: If omitted, original value carries over. OCC pass-through. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: NoLegs
Field.Description: Leg component block. Must match the original order. 2 to 10.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Leg reference id, unique per leg.

Field.Name: LegMaturityDate
Field.Description: Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP.

Field.Name: LegStrikePrice
Field.Description: Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP.

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell, 5 Sell Short, 6 Sell Short Exempt.

Message.Name: NewOrderCrossMultileg
Message.Description: Submits two-sided multi-leg auction orders (Facilitation, Solicitation, PIM), or multi-leg CCC or QCC orders. Two to ten legs. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of times the spread is available.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Net price of the spread to the originating side. Positive Debit, negative Credit, 0 Even.

Field.Name: ExDestination
Field.Description: Required for QCC with routed stock component. CHBC, LBKI, FOGS, BNY.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: If provided, must be XISX (ISE Exchange).

Field.Name: CrossID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the entire crossing order.

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: S Solicitation, C CCC, F Facilitation, P PIM, Q QCC.

Field.Name: NoSides
Field.Description: 2. First side originating, second side counter-party.

Field.Name: StepUpPrice
Field.Description: At or better than auction price, or 0 for Market. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: StepUpPriceType
Field.Description: 1 Market, 2 Limit. Required when StepUpPrice provided. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: ExposureFlag
Field.Description: C Customer ID, E Expose All, G Give-Up, M CMTA. E mutually exclusive. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: BrokerPct
Field.Description: 0 to 40 (default 40). Facilitation and PIM only. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: UnderlyingPx
Field.Description: Traded price of the stock trade associated with the QCC order.

Field.Name: UnderlyingQty
Field.Description: Traded quantity of the stock trade associated with the QCC order.

Field.Name: PriceDelta
Field.Description: Price delta of the stock trade associated with the QCC order. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Leg reference id, unique per leg.

Field.Name: LegMaturityDate
Field.Description: Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP.

Field.Name: LegStrikePrice
Field.Description: Required if LegCFICode is OC or OP.

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell, 5 Sell Short, 6 Sell Short Exempt.

Field.Name: ContraLegPositionEffect
Field.Description: Required for crossing orders, option leg only. O Open, C Close. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: ContraSideShortSell
Field.Description: Optional for crossing orders, stock leg only. 5 Sell Short, 6 Sell Short Exempt. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: 0 for busts or other post-trade corrections.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: 0 for busts or other post-trade corrections.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Market that executed the stock leg, or away execution exchange for option linkage trades.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the exchange. Not provided for busts or post-trade allocations.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 Buy, 2 Sell, 5 Sell Short, 6 Sell Short Exempt.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: If provided in the original order. Always populated in busts/PTA actions.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: 0 if Canceled or Rejected, otherwise OrderQty minus CumQty.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: CS, OPT, or MLEG (configurable by request).

Field.Name: DayOrderQty
Field.Description: GTC/GTD only. OrderQty minus contracts traded on previous days.

Field.Name: DayCumQty
Field.Description: GTC/GTD only. Contracts traded today. 0 for busts/PTA.

Field.Name: DayAvgPx
Field.Description: GTC/GTD only. Average price of contracts traded today. 0 for busts/PTA.

Field.Name: MultiLegReportingType
Field.Description: 2 Individual leg of a multi-leg security, 3 Multi-leg security.

Field.Name: SideTradeID
Field.Description: Carried to OCC TrdID field. NON-STANDARD (FIX 5.0SP2 EP107).

Field.Name: BranchSeqNbr
Field.Description: Blank if not provided on the incoming order request.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: MPID. First field in repeating group. Required if NoContraBrokers > 0. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2. For exchange-listed securities: 4-char MPID or 4-char exchange Exchange Values: American Stock Exchange = AMEX Boston Stock Exchange = BOSX Cincinnati Stock Exchange = CINN Chicago Stock Exchange = XMSE International Stock Exchage = INSE New York Stock Exchang

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Number of ContraBrokers repeating group instances. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: MPID. First field in repeating group. Required if NoContraBrokers > 0. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2. For exchange-listed securities: 4-char MPID or 4-char exchange Exchange Values: American Stock Exchange = AMEX Boston Stock Exchange = BOSX Cincinnati Stock Exchange = CINN Chicago Stock Exchange = XMSE International Stock Exchage = INSE New York Stock Exchang

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Number of ContraBrokers repeating group instances. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID from the prior order for unsolicited cancels.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID from the prior order for unsolicited cancels.

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: For restatements always 5 (Partial decline of OrderQty).

Message.Name: Allocation
Message.Description: Post-trade clearing change. A trade can only be altered once and split a maximum of ten times; current day's trades only.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Underlying symbol of the option series.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total quantity of the original execution.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: OCC options symbol for a series.

Field.Name: AllocID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the Allocation message.

Field.Name: AllocShares
Field.Description: Quantity for this allocation. Sum of all AllocShares must equal Shares.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Give-up. 1 to 99999. Required on every post-trade allocation.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Client/clearing category. Cannot change Customer to Firm.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: YYYYMMDD. Required unless 200 and 205 are specified.

Message.Name: AllocationAck
Message.Description: Acknowledges or rejects the Allocation request.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Date the Allocation Ack was generated.

Message.Name: MemberKillSwitch
Message.Description: Blocks a Firm or specific port from entering or altering orders and deletes all open orders for the Firm/port, regardless of exchange. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: PartyDetailID
Field.Description: Firm or Port account to be blocked (e.g. ABCD or FIXBC1).

Field.Name: PartyDetailRole
Field.Description: 59 Executing Unit, 55 Session ID (Port). Port-level blocking currently not supported.

Message.Name: MemberKillSwitchResponse
Message.Description: Acknowledges the Member Kill Switch request. NON-STANDARD (ISE).

Field.Name: PartyDetailID
Field.Description: Firm or Port to be blocked.

Message.Name: BusinessMessageReject
Message.Description: Rejects an application message that passes session-level rules but cannot be rejected by other means (e.g. an order missing a required ISE-specific field).

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: ID of the rejected message (e.g. ClOrdID).

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number. First logon of the day uses 1.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: As assigned by ISE (member to ISE). ISE on outbound messages.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Service bureau firmId to route orders on behalf of a member. Four characters, assigned by ISE.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ISE (member to ISE). As assigned by ISE on outbound messages.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for resend messages. Same value as SendingTime if data is unavailable.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three-digit checksum. Always the last field.
